claim: Jacobs states that it has implemented more than 100 asset management systems in the United States and worldwide.
JC Solutions presents a $300,000 worth-of-investments value-add callout.
The AMS is stated to align with ISO 55001 standards and use the 10-Box Model.
Corrective-maintenance work orders are stated to be issued within 24 hours of detection and closed within 120 days.
The asset-management approach supports five- and 10-year capital improvement planning.
Field-trained maintenance specialists are stated to have completed condition assessments for 1 million water and wastewater plant assets.
The equipment performance testing plan is to be completed and implemented within 180 days from contract commencement.
